PHACTboost_score.reason: Plan marked it low-confidence pending a check of the training target. Dereli et al. 2024 train on ClinVar, gnomAD and HSV; the Atlas lists it as clinical-trained (R2.7).

Polyphen2_HVAR_score.reason: HumVar is UniProt disease-causing versus common variants; the plan's own level 2 includes curated UniProt disease sets (R2.7).

MPC_score.reason: MPC combines missense badness, PolyPhen-2 and regional constraint. PolyPhen-2 is in the panel, so the plan's ensemble rule excludes it (R2.7).

atlas_source.source: Atlas of Variant Effects Alliance, coding VEP table (compiled by B. Livesey and T. Walsh, Marsh lab, University of Edinburgh)
atlas_source.use: External classification of predictor training (Population-free / Population-tuned / Clinical-trained), suggested by Reviewer 2 (R2.7). Read by scripts/rebuild/33_dbnsfp_matched.py; not edited by hand.
